# CallProof Complaint Evidence Packet

Capability ID: callproof-complaint-packet-machine-v1
Commercial state: verify
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/callproof-complaint-packet-machine-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- organize my robocall evidence
- make an FCC complaint packet
- organize unwanted call records
- help me document spam calls
- prepare my FTC call evidence
- turn my call log into a complaint packet

## Problem

Organize a user's own unwanted-call or text records and evidence into a factual packet for review before optional FCC or FTC filing.

## Inputs

Authenticated user-owned incident records, with optional contact details, notes and evidence references.

## Outputs

Downloadable factual incident packet. CallProof does not file the complaint or determine that a law was violated.

## Pricing

Published app pricing: $19 one-time packet, $7.99/month Vault, $29/month Pro. Live Stripe checkout price is authoritative.

- Stop-The-Calls Packet: $19 (one_time)

- Vault: $7.99/month (subscription)

- Pro: $29/month (subscription)
